name: zovo-jar-viewer
displayName: JAR Viewer & Java Decompiler (Class File Viewer, Bytecode, CFR)
description: JAR viewer and Java decompiler for VS Code: open .jar, .war, .ear, .aar and .class files, browse packages and resources, read MANIFEST.MF, the Java version of each class, a javap-style bytecode listing and decompiled Java source (CFR, when a Java runtime is installed). Also a class file viewer. Read-only, no network.

jarViewer.javaPath.description: Java runtime used to decompile with CFR: a java binary or a JDK/JRE folder. Empty: JAVA_HOME, then java on PATH. Without Java the viewer shows bytecode only.

jarViewer.showProTools.description: Show the Export sources, Compare and Find in folder buttons (Zovo Pro tools, 3 free tries each). Turn off to hide them.

jarViewer.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Rate, More free viewers and support links at the bottom of the viewer.

jarViewer.askForRating.description: Ask once, after a few days of use, whether you want to rate the extension. Never after an error.

walkthroughs.title: JAR Viewer & Java Decompiler
walkthroughs.description: Browse JAR files and read Java classes without leaving VS Code.

steps.title: Open a JAR
steps.description:
Click any .jar, .war, .ear or .aar file in the Explorer: it opens in the viewer with its packages, resources and MANIFEST.MF.
[Open the sample JAR](command:jarViewer.openSample?%22jar%22)
[Open a file...](command:jarViewer.open)

steps.title: Bytecode and Java source
steps.description:
Click a class to read its decompiled Java source, a javap-style bytecode listing, its fields and methods and its constant pool. Each class shows the Java version it was compiled for.
[Open a sample class](command:jarViewer.openSample?%22class%22)

steps.title: Turn on decompiling
steps.description:
Decompiling runs the bundled CFR decompiler on a Java runtime (8 or newer) on your computer: JAVA_HOME, java on PATH, or the setting below. The bytecode view needs no Java.
[Check the Java runtime](command:jarViewer.checkJava)
[Open the setting](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22jarViewer.javaPath%22)

steps.title: Files that often come with Java archives
steps.description:
If your project also has archives or binary files, these free Zovo extensions open them. A link opens the extension page, and you choose there whether to install it.
[ZIP Explorer](command:extension.open?%5B%22zovo.zip-archive-explorer%22%5D)
[Hex Viewer](command:extension.open?%5B%22zovo.zovo-hex-viewer%22%5D)
